sections.title: Sound of letter be
paragraphs: The name of this letter is (бэ) /bɛ/. Its main sound is heard in (брат) /brat/, which means brother. This letter makes four different sounds.

sections.title: How to say be
paragraphs: To make the first sound, close both lips and build up air. Open your lips quickly with your voice turned on. To make the second sound, lift the middle of your tongue while saying it. For the third sound, close your lips and release the air with no voice. For the fourth sound, lift your tongue and keep your voice off. Put a hand on your throat to feel it shake.

sections.title: Reading letter be
paragraphs: Before hard vowels and voiced consonants, read (бык) /bɨk/. Before soft vowels or a soft sign, read (белый) /ˈbʲe.ɫɨj/. At the end of a word, say (лоб) /lop/. Before a voiceless consonant, say (юбка) /ˈjup.kə/. When soft at the end of a word, read (дробь) /dropʲ/.

sections.title: Mistakes to avoid
paragraphs: Do not puff out air like the English b in boat. Keep the burst very crisp and short. Do not keep your voice turned on at the end of a word like in rib. Turn your voice completely off so it sounds like the p in rip.
